_doc: Regions of Nyxarys (Regions.gd; docs/lore/ELEDORIA_ATLAS.md). The Guild's town is Nexus. Players choose a birthplace town at character creation; adventurers get one from their race's homelands. Same region = a little warmer at first.

radiant_plains.name: The Radiant Plains
radiant_plains.description: Open sunlit country. The Grand Cathedral of the Divine Light stands at Solara's Beacon.

verdant_glades.name: The Verdant Glades
verdant_glades.description: The heartland forest that breathes for the world; home of the Circle of the Verdant Heart.

wildwood_expanse.name: The Wildwood Expanse
wildwood_expanse.description: Untamed woods of hunters and the hunted; the Howl of the War Wolf gathers at Fangclaw.

gloomshroud.name: The Gloomshroud
gloomshroud.description: Mire and bone-grey ridges where the dead are kept.

veiled_realm.name: The Veiled Realm
veiled_realm.description: A crescent of mist and moonlight; somewhere in it hides Kiri no Kage.

mystical_highlands.name: The Mystical Highlands
mystical_highlands.description: Lakes, springs and bays where the Spirit Weaver's blood pooled.

iron_hills.name: The Iron Hills
iron_hills.description: Hills of ore and walls; the Iron Gauntlet guild keeps its hall at Ironhold.

warforged_lands.name: The Warforged Lands
warforged_lands.description: An island of forges and training grounds; the Amakiri Reiken school trains at Warforge.

enchanted_archipelago.name: The Enchanted Archipelago
enchanted_archipelago.description: Five isles, five elements: the heart that burst in the Shattering.

northern_wilds.name: The Northern Wilds
northern_wilds.description: Shards of Nyxara's essence, frozen and half-asleep under the ice.
